title: An Algorithmic Account of Few-Shot Concept Induction in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Both models and minds not only encode features that describe an entity, but can specifically represent which features of that entity are relevant for a given context. This core capability underlies in-context learning in language models and a variety of cognitive phenomena in minds, yet it is unclear how intelligent systems identify and promote relevant features. In this work, we propose Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA), an algorithmic hypothesis that provides an explanation for how relevance is determined in the context of few-shot concept induction --- the ability to infer a latent concept from a small number of positive examples. Under ADA, concept induction proceeds by forming a summary representation of the examples in a feature space that is shaped by amortized knowledge about which features tend to be useful for finding commonalities between items. translated_title: 语言模型中少样本概念归纳的算法性解释
translated_abstract: 模型和心智不仅编码描述实体的特征，还能具体表示该实体的哪些特征与给定情境相关。这一核心能力是语言模型上下文学习以及心智中多种认知现象的基础，然而智能系统如何识别和提升相关特征仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出了摊销方向强化，这是一个算法性假设，为少样本概念归纳情境下相关性如何确定提供了解释——少样本概念归纳是指从少量正例中推断出潜在概念的能力。在ADA框架下，概念归纳通过在一个特征空间中形成示例的摘要表示来进行，而该特征空间由关于哪些特征通常有助于发现项目间共性的摊销知识所塑造。我们使用少样本概念归纳任务在语言模型中研究并验证了ADA。
tldr: 本文提出摊销方向强化（ADA）这一算法性假设，解释了语言模型在少样本概念归纳中如何确定特征相关性，即通过利用关于哪些特征有助于发现共性的摊销知识来构建特征空间中示例的摘要表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA), an algorithmic hypothesis explaining how language models determine feature relevance in few-shot concept induction by forming summary representations of examples in a feature space shaped by amortized knowledge about which features are useful for finding commonalities between items.
